name: manageHospitalSettings
shortDescription: Allows administrators to update and manage hospital-specific configuration settings and policies.
description:
Overview

Provides functionality for administrators to configure hospital-wide settings such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

Intended use

Called by the admin-facing UI when an administrator modifies hospital settings. It receives parameters like settingName and settingValue.

Logic

  1. Validate the incoming params for settingName and settingValue to ensure data integrity.
  2. Update the HospitalSetting record using ctx.data.upsert (or ctx.data.update if the setting already exists based on settingName).
  3. Audit-log the setting change using ctx.audit.log, detailing which setting was changed and by whom.
  4. Return the updated HospitalSetting record.

Entities

  • HospitalSetting
